title: [E16-07] Transactional Audit and Reliable Outbox Events
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-07 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to add transaction-bound audit and outbox events, so I can preserve reliable events.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** C — Controlled pilot — after operational gates  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:C`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30), [E16-01](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/32)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-11, E16-01.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Order and audit update atomic, retry-safe notifications.
- [ ] Commit business mutation, critical audit and outbox event in the same database transaction.
- [ ] Publish notifications/jobs after commit with retryable delivery and unique event IDs.
- [ ] Deduplicate consumers and handle failure without losing or duplicating domain effects.
- [ ] Redact secrets/personal payloads and record observable outbox failure state.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use Prisma transactions and OutboxEvent/AuditEvent; avoid distributed microservices before there is a demonstrated need.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Force rollback and dispatcher failure; verify no orphan audit/event on rollback and one consumer effect after recovery.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
